description: This file defines the AsyncConfig class for managing asynchronous execution settings in the AgentField SDK, including polling strategies, resource limits, timeouts, caching, retries, and environment variable configuration.

classes.name: AsyncConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for async execution behavior, managing polling intervals, resource limits, timeouts, caching, retries, and environment variable loading.

methods.name: from_environment
methods.description: Creates an AsyncConfig instance with parameters loaded from environment variables.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the configuration parameters to ensure they are within logical and acceptable ranges.

methods.name: get_poll_interval_for_age
methods.description: Returns the appropriate polling interval based on the age of an execution.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the current configuration.
